title: Dates have no house format
summary: Every area writes dates several ways: Sep 29, 09/29/2026, Sep 29, 2026, relative words like Yesterday, and year-less dates outside the current year. Ranges switch between en dash, hyphen and "to".

title: Money goes through several different renderers
summary: Cents are superscript in some tables and flat in cards and review steps; negatives use three different minus characters; thousands are K or k; foreign amounts get a dollar sign. Each surface seems to pick its own money component.

title: Title Case slips into a sentence-case UI
summary: The product is mostly sentence case, but dialog titles, buttons, badges and menu items in Title Case sit next to their sentence-case twins, sometimes for the same label.

title: Form errors are reported in four different ways
summary: Inline red text, tooltips, disabled submit buttons and silent no-ops all appear for the same situation (an empty or invalid required field), and error copy changes voice and punctuation.

title: Same role, different button
summary: Back, dismiss, acknowledge and secondary actions switch between components, sizes (32 vs 40px), emphasis and even link vs button inside one flow.

title: Buttons that look disabled but aren't
summary: Primary buttons are dimmed to signal an incomplete form, yet some still submit, some validate and some do nothing. The visual state doesn't predict behaviour.

title: Status colour doesn't carry one meaning
summary: The same tint marks unrelated states (one orange for paused, failed, eligible and personal), failures keep success colours, and some statuses are badges only when they go wrong.

title: No shared empty state
summary: Empty tables and panels use unrelated layouts, sizes and glyphs (dash, em dash, blank, "No results"), sometimes over loading skeletons.

title: Destructive actions are confirmed unevenly
summary: Canceling asks for confirmation while declining does not; disabling a rule is confirmed but enabling self-approval is not; delete dialogs follow three templates.

title: Success feedback varies
summary: Toasts differ in wording and punctuation, some actions end with a full success screen, others with nothing, and a few say things like "Removed 1 statements".

title: Controls and headings without proper semantics
summary: Kebab menus, row icons and tabs are unnamed buttons or clickable divs, and modal titles skip heading levels or aren't headings at all, so screen readers announce "button" or nothing.

title: Dates computed in UTC show up as tomorrow
summary: In the evening (Pacific), newly created tokens, journal entries and bills are stamped with tomorrow's date, which suggests UTC is used where local time is expected.

title: Lists don't update after an action
summary: Paid bills stay in the inbox, approved tasks stay in Tasks, canceled invoices vanish without totals changing: the UI and its counts drift from the action just taken.

title: Account numbers are masked three ways
summary: Account numbers show different dot counts, partial masks, or no mask at all on review screens.

title: Punctuation inside link text
summary: Inline links that end a sentence swallow the sentence's period ('accounting settings.', 'Learn more.', 'View API docs.', 'our Help Center.'), so the period is underlined and clickable. Rule under test: no link text ends with a final period. Related: rule template cards carry an invisible '.' in their accessible names.
